sections.name: File setup, PortfolioView
sections.title: Imports and view names
sections.what: Brings in the address and industry context tools and lists the five portfolio views: summary, forecast, dataset, companies and map.
sections.why: Likely reason: a fixed list keeps every view name spelled the same way across the app.
sections.watch_out: Adding a view means updating this list and the path helper, or TypeScript will reject links to it.

sections.name: viewPath
sections.title: Building the address for a view
sections.what: Returns the page address for a view. The summary sits at the portfolio root. Other views sit under the portfolio path, or under the industry page when one industry is selected, where companies uses the word directory.
sections.why: Likely reason: the companies view is named directory in the address, so the mapping is made explicit here.
sections.watch_out: The word directory is written into this file, so it must match the app's page address setup, which is not shown in this packet.

sections.name: usePortfolioState
sections.title: Shared portfolio state hook
sections.what: Gives views the current industry, the filters read from the address, a way to change address settings, a helper that builds links carrying the shared filters, and a way to move to a new address.
sections.why: Likely reason: one shared hook keeps every view reading and writing the same settings.
sections.watch_out: Changes made in the same moment can overwrite each other, because each one starts from the address as it was last drawn.

summary: A shared helper that keeps the portfolio's filters and page settings in the web address and builds links that carry them to other views.
purpose: Lets every portfolio view read and change the same filters, and move between views without losing them.
why: Likely reason: storing the state in the web address means a filtered view can be bookmarked or shared by its address.
how: Reads the current industry from the app context. Reads the address settings and turns them into filters. Provides a function that merges changes into the address and drops the page number when filters change. Provides a helper that builds a link to any view carrying the shared filters. Provides a helper that turns a view name into its page path.
inputs: The current industry context, the current web address settings, and the changes requested by the views.
outputs: The industry slug and name, the parsed filters and settings, functions to change the address and build links, and the router's location setter.
risks: Changes made in the same moment can overwrite each other, because each one starts from the address as it was last drawn. The shared link helper only carries a fixed list of parameter names, so a new filter that is not on that list will be dropped from links.
debug: If a filter does not survive a reload, check it is handled in the parameter reading step and in the link helper's list. If a link loses filters, check that list. If a view opens at the wrong path, check the view path helper. If two filters seem to apply only one, suspect overlapping address updates.
